description: The City and County of Denver publishes polygons for bridges and retaining walls within its boundary. Coverage includes city-owned and other owners’ structures; the provider identifies the latter through LEGACY_ID values containing NONCCD. The schema lists structure number and name, construction year, owner, structure type, length and width in feet. These footprints and asset attributes can support infrastructure exposure and road-network resilience research. They do not establish load capacity, condition, fragility or whether each structure carries a public road. Observation currency and feature completeness remain unverified. Denver labels these data as not for engineering purposes and disclaims their accuracy and completeness. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies provider use constraints. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue.
